ent_algorithm_ppo.name: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
ent_algorithm_ppo.summary: A policy-gradient reinforcement-learning algorithm that constrains update steps to avoid destructive policy changes and improve sample efficiency.
ent_algorithm_ppo.body:
## Overview
A policy gradient reinforcement learning algorithm that avoids destructive changes and improves sample efficiency by limiting the step size of policy updates.

## Content
### Definition and Positioning of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)
Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) belongs to the **algorithm** type. Its domain includes: AI models and algorithms. Value chain level: intelligence layer. It is a policy gradient reinforcement learning algorithm that avoids destructive changes and improves sample efficiency by limiting the step size of policy updates. Its English name is *Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)*. Its Korean name is *근위 정책 최적화(PPO)*.

ent_algorithm_sac.body:
## Overview

## Content
